# GeoPersona Analytics Context
# Format: llms.txt v1.0

> GeoPersona Analytics is an enterprise demographic synthesis engine modeling macroeconomic workforce sectors, household structures, telecom ISP infrastructure, and data plausibility heuristics.

## Public Core Routes
- https://geopersona.example.com/ : Main Analytics Engine, parameter controls, regional workforce models.
- https://geopersona.example.com/privacy : Privacy policy and telemetry handling.
- https://geopersona.example.com/terms : Terms of service and synthetic validation boundaries.

## Key Capabilities
- Regional Labor Mapping: Synthesizes top 3 localized economic industries and resident occupations.
- Biological & Chronological Constraints: Validates age-conditioned parent-child spacing and academic timelines.
- ISP Telemetry: Resolves Autonomous System Numbers (ASN) to dominant regional access networks.
- Cryptographic Steganography: Verifies origin watermarks signed with HMAC-SHA256.
